How to use Yogprabha Facade Studio

Try colours and finishes on the Yogprabha exterior. The 2D views are the R5 elevations, and the 3D view is the project's SketchUp model. The building's shape never changes, only colours and finishes.

1 · Start from a combination

Click any of the 11 Recommended combinations on the left (number 1 is the model exactly as designed in SketchUp). It applies to all four sides and the 3D model at once.

2 · Change any part

  • Pick an element on the right (main walls, terracotta frame, orange panels, wood cladding, grey panels, glazing, dark strip, railings, ground floor, top), or just click that part on the drawing or the 3D model.
  • Choose a colour from the swatches or Custom colour, then a finish (paint, textured paint, concrete, brick, stone, wood, metal, tiles, glass). Pattern size scales bricks, stones and planks.
  • Gloss and Reflectivity control how shiny a surface looks in 3D. For glass, the colour is the tint.
  • In 3D, clicking a part opens Paint: choose Just this part, All matching (the same part on every floor) or Whole element, then pick a colour or finish. Shift+click selects more parts; Esc clears.
  • If a part landed in the wrong element, click it and use Wrong element type? to move it.

3 · Views

  • All 4 sides / East / North / West / South show the flat elevations. Use − Fit + to zoom.
  • 3D view: drag to orbit, right-drag or Shift+drag to pan, scroll to zoom toward the cursor (right up to any balcony), W A S D to move, Q/E up/down. Go to view flies the camera to set spots: each facade, corners, entrance, a balcony close-up, the crown and a top view. The Section slider cuts the model at any height.
  • Time slider: move the sun from morning to night. At night, the window lights come on.
  • Compare with… splits the 3D view: your scheme on the left, another combination on the right. Drag the handle to wipe between them.

4 · Save & share

Download image saves the flat elevations as a PNG. In 3D view it saves a brochure-style render named after the colour combination, with its swatches. PDF brochure saves a 5-page A4 brochure: cover, the four facades, detail views, the R5 elevations in your colours, and a schedule of every element with its finish, colour code and Asian Paints shade. Type the Asian Paints shade for each element and it appears on the brochure. Share link copies a link that opens this exact scheme. Your last setup is remembered when you reopen the file. Reset goes back to the start.

Note: the 3D model is the project's SketchUp model (new_model_may13, COLLADA export) used as-is, with its original materials as the elements. Only colours and finishes change.
